work.work-title: Morning has Broken - Three Variations with a Prelude and Postlude

credit.credit-words: Variations with a Prelude and Postlude
Based on the Anonymous, Traditional Gaelic Melody known as Bunessan

direction-type.words: I made this arrangement with intermediate and advanced piano students in mind. The Intro and Postlude (bars 1-25 and 105-end) are mine. The three variations could
correspond freely to the three strophes of the lyrics written in 1931 by Eleanor Farjeon to fit the traditional Gaelic tune
. The song became very popular after
British singer Cat Stevens' 1971 version. I encourage the reader and player to find more information about Morning has Broken, easily found on the internet.
